reconcile.note: Matthew Henry and Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read Christ's light burden as inward rest amid genuine hardship, not a promise that discipleship escapes suffering or persecution.

sides.snippet: my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
sides.verseText: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.\"

sides.snippet: all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
sides.verseText: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
